theorems.name: Submission.ball_convolution_contDiff_laplacian_eq_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ w : Rn n → ℝ, IntegrableOn w (ball (0 : Rn n) 1) → (∀ ζ : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball 0 1 → ∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, w x * Laplacian.laplacian ζ x = 0) → ∀ (κ : Rn n → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ → (∀ z : Rn n, ε ≤ ‖z‖ → κ z = 0) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => ∫ y in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, κ (x - y) * w y) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (1 - ε), Laplacian.laplacian (fun x => ∫ y in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, κ (x - y) * w y) x = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
